title: coland interop: PQ-only TLS probe can't pass with coland's own rustls, and would lock out OpenSSL 3.0 peers
description:
Side: coland (deployment; affects any MIMI peer).

When COLAND_PQ_TLS_DEPLOYMENT_PROBE is unset, coland requires its public endpoint to negotiate TLS 1.3 X25519MLKEM768 and to reject classical TLS 1.3 and TLS 1.2 (crates/server/src/tls_probe.rs). Two problems:
(a) coland's own rustls listener (COLAND_TLS_CERT_PATH) uses salvo RustlsConfig::new, with ALL_VERSIONS and aws-lc-rs default kx groups (X25519MLKEM768, X25519, P-256, P-384). It accepts classical clients, so coland serving TLS itself would fail its own probe. Only a PQ-only external terminator could pass it.
(b) A PQ-only endpoint would lock out OpenSSL 3.0 peers (Debian 12), including mimid's socat mTLS proxy and curl.
This deployment uses Caddy 2.6.2 (classical TLS) with COLAND_PQ_TLS_DEPLOYMENT_PROBE=unverified-classical-caddy. The probe is skipped, /readyz stays 503 pq_hybrid_tls_probe_missing, and all routes serve normally, because the flag gates only /readyz and the describe hardening snapshot.
